description: This file contains data transfer object (DTO) models and request validation classes for various asset-related entities in the backend of a data asset management system. It includes models for asset status logs, additional asset IDs, asset properties, control device mappings, input parameters, parent input mappings, reporting attributes, EF source mappings, throughput equations and scalars, data input values, and associated create/update request classes with validation logic.

classes.name: AssetStatusLogDto
classes.description: DTO representing a persisted log of an asset’s operating status, mapping to the 'asset_status_log' table.

classes.name: CreateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new asset status log record, includes validation for status dates.

classes.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an existing asset status log record.

classes.name: AdditionalAssetIdDto
classes.description: DTO representing an additional identifier for an asset, mapping to 'additional_asset_id' table.

classes.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating additional asset ID entries.

classes.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating additional asset ID entries.

classes.name: AssetPropertyDto
classes.description: DTO for a persisted asset property record linking to 'asset_property' table.

classes.name: CreateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating asset properties.

classes.name: UpdateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating asset properties.

classes.name: ControlDeviceMappingDto
classes.description: DTO representing control device mappings tied to assets in 'control_device_mapping' table.

classes.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating control device mappings.

classes.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating control device mappings.

classes.name: InputParameterDto
classes.description: DTO for input parameters, including domain validation for 'in-use' status.

classes.name: CreateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating input parameters with validation for required UOM and reporting program when active.

classes.name: UpdateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating input parameters, with similar validation as creation.

classes.name: ParentInputMappingDto
classes.description: DTO representing parent-child input parameter relationships.

classes.name: CreateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model to create parent input mapping entries.

classes.name: UpdateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model to update parent input mappings.

classes.name: ReportingAttributeMappingDto
classes.description: DTO mapping reporting attributes to reports for assets.

classes.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating reporting attribute mappings.

classes.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating reporting attribute mappings.

classes.name: EfSourceMappingDto
classes.description: DTO for EF source mappings, including validation for reporting program presence.

classes.name: CreateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Create request with validation for EF source mappings.

classes.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Update request for EF source mappings, with optional reporting program ID.

classes.name: ThroughputEquationDto
classes.description: DTO for throughput equations, linking input parameters to equations.

classes.name: CreateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Create request with normalization logic and validation for throughput equations.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Update request with similar validation and normalization as creation.

classes.name: ThroughputScalarDto
classes.description: DTO for throughput scalar values.

classes.name: CreateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Request model for throughput scalar creation, including normalization for scalar type and values.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Update request for throughput scalar, with normalization.

classes.name: DataInputValueDto
classes.description: DTO representing data input values linked to input parameters.

classes.name: CreateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Create request for data input values.

classes.name: UpdateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Update request for data input values.
